evidenceLevels.source: Direct source operation or manufacturer documentation.
evidenceLevels.process: Proposed dependency preventing access from being deferred; not a collision certificate.
evidenceLevels.unresolved: Installed socket frame, plug sweep or physical access is not established.

sources.supports: JST EHR-03 / B3B-EH-A, GND/VDD/DATA pin definition; not installed connector coordinates.
Manufacturer drawing shows two side ports; no registered port-centre coordinates for this guide.

gates.prepare: With both motors still loose, identify both keyed side ports and label the assigned local leads. Seat the required motor ends before the plate and thigh are fitted.
gates.freeEnd: Leave each neighbouring-motor end free; do not close a loop across an unassembled joint.
gates.route: Bring the free ends through the still-open side of the thigh station before the plate. No closed-hole passage or installed socket sweep has yet been validated.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: Connect the assigned ankle-motor ends while the motor is outside the fork.
gates.freeEnd: Keep the knee-side end free until the lower/ankle group has been positioned at the knee.
gates.route: Use the open fork during preparation; keep the cable clear of the sleeve pocket and output boss. The wired motor insertion requires a new check.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: Check seated plugs and wire departure before the lower-link sleeve/boss fit closes.
gates.freeEnd: Keep the upper connection free while moving the complete lower/ankle group.
gates.route: Keep all cable material outside the sleeve, locating pegs, mating seam and output bearing. Do not pull wire through the interference-fit sleeve.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: Inspect ankle wire departure and free slack before seating the foot.
gates.freeEnd: Keep any still-unconnected upper end visible.
gates.route: Do not route under the foot retaining boss. This is a checkpoint, not evidence that the foot itself blocks the connector.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: With the yaw motor loose, identify and pre-seat its assigned motor ends before the yaw link is fitted.
gates.freeEnd: Leave the roll-side and torso-side destinations free until their separate stations are ready.
gates.route: Keep leads out of the four inward-facing yaw screw tool corridors; finish those screws at step14 before adding the roll motor.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: Pre-seat assigned roll-motor ends on the open bench; verify the yaw plugs before the roll motor and passive support are introduced.
gates.freeEnd: Do not connect the thigh-side free end until the entire yaw/roll group is at the hip.
gates.route: Pass free ends out of the open bench station before its supports close; avoid case screw seats and rear retainer.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: Check hip-pitch plug seating and outgoing lead position while the yaw/roll group is still separate.
gates.freeEnd: Leave the roll-group end free until its single-axis join.
gates.route: Keep the lead away from both perpendicular shaft seats and support rings. Do not thread a plugged housing through a seated ring.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

gates.prepare: Keep motor-end plugs seated and carry their cables with the complete yaw/roll group. Join the remaining local free ends only after the group is seated and all required housing passages are complete.
gates.freeEnd: Keep the torso interface free for the open-torso station.
gates.route: Preserve a visible service loop across the roll joint; no measured length, bend radius or joint sweep is accepted by this process gate.
check: Identify the actual housing and key; no bbox-centre target.
Confirm plug shoulders are seated with no wire caught in a seam.
Keep the neighbouring end free until housing passage is finished.
acceptanceRequired: Register actual socket frame to the source motor CAD.
Check complete connector body and attached cable through the proposed station motion.
Confirm free-end threading and observable seating on the actual hardware.

recovery.firstAction: Inspect both physical side ports with power disconnected. If a plug seats directly, remove no part. Support the leg and use only a comfortable existing joint pose; no forced joint movement.
recovery.prohibitedInference: Do not remove a structural plate solely because it overlaps the motor bounding box.

candidateLocalStations.note: The plate is part of case/rear retention; it is not proven to be a detachable cosmetic cover.
These retain perpendicular shafts and the case. A verified local removal path and exact retained screw set are required before recommending removal.
Existing guide has unresolved sleeve/boss and foot fit. Do not reverse those fits merely to reach a cable.
